notes: Goldman's real listing is Higher (higher.gs.com), a Next.js app posting to https://api-higher.gs.com/gateway/api/v1/graphql. Introspection confirms RoleSearchQueryInput fields page, sort, searchTerm, experiences and filters; filters is a list of RoleSearchFilterTypeInput {filterCategoryType, filters}. RoleSearchFilterCategoryType enum = EXPERIENCE_LEVEL, DIVISION, JOB_FUNCTION, LOCATION, RECRUITING_TYPE, SKILL, SKILLSET, EDUCATION_LEVEL, GRADUATION_YEAR. Results and Campus are separate experiences (results covers EARLY_CAREER+PROFESSIONAL, campus covers CAMPUS). No Oracle-style keyword/location params are used by the live portal.
